items.question: What adornment and placement is prescribed for the meditated form?
premises: The form is seated in that place.
It is adorned with white ornaments.
items.inference: The meditated form is seated and white-ornamented.
uncertainties: Exact seat not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: That seated form is adorned with white ornaments.

items.question: How should the meditated form be ritually bathed and remembered?
premises: It is sprinkled with milk-water and all ingredients.
One should remember it.
items.inference: The form is bathed and remembered.
items.plain_english: Sprinkle it with milk-water and all ingredients, and remember it.

items.question: What playful and wish-formed result arises from this meditation?
premises: It plays with various enjoyments.
A wish-form becomes.
items.inference: The practice yields playful enjoyment and a wish-form.
items.plain_english: It plays with various enjoyments, and a wish-form arises.

items.question: What lunar meditation posture and striking process is described?
premises: Having meditated, the form is seated on a moon seat.
It is struck above by the moon.
items.inference: Lunar meditation involves a moon seat and striking.
items.plain_english: Having meditated, it is seated on a moon seat and struck above by the moon.

items.question: What freedom from aging, death, and disease results?
premises: It is freed from old age and death.
It is devoid of all disease.
items.inference: The result is freedom from aging, death, and disease.
items.plain_english: It is freed from old age and death and devoid of all disease.

items.question: What wonderful additional teaching is addressed to the goddess?
premises: Another wonderful thing is presented.
The goddess is asked to hear.
items.inference: A new wonderful teaching follows.
items.plain_english: Hear another wonderful thing, O goddess, O family-minded one.

items.question: What happens to old age and disease through this meditation?
premises: This is being meditated, O goddess.
Old age and disease are destroyed.
items.inference: Meditation destroys old age and disease.
items.plain_english: O goddess, when this is meditated, old age and disease are destroyed.

items.question: Where should this moon be meditated according to the verse?
premises: One should meditate this moon, O goddess.
It is in navel and head and in the heart.
items.inference: The moon is meditated in navel, head, and heart.
items.plain_english: O goddess, one should meditate this moon in navel, head, and heart.

items.question: What independence and freedom from aging and death result?
premises: Then independence is attained.
It is devoid of old age and death.
items.inference: The result is independent freedom from aging and death.
items.plain_english: Then one attains independence devoid of old age and death.

items.question: What thousand-petaled beautiful form is described?
premises: It is endowed with thousand-petal beauty.
It resembles white cow's milk.
items.inference: The form is thousand-petaled and milk-white.
items.plain_english: It is endowed with thousand-petal beauty and resembles white cow's milk.

items.question: How is the form mounted and flooded by wheels?
premises: It is mounted on the lower wheel.
It is flooded by the upper wheel.
items.inference: The form is mounted below and flooded above by wheels.
items.plain_english: Mounted on the lower wheel, it is flooded by the upper wheel.

items.question: What freedom from wrinkles, grey hair, and disease results?
premises: It is freed from wrinkles and grey hair.
It is devoid of all disease.
items.inference: The result removes wrinkles, grey hair, and disease.
items.plain_english: Freed from wrinkles and grey hair, it is devoid of all disease.

items.question: What further wonderful teaching requires one-pointed hearing?
premises: Another wonderful thing is presented.
Hear with one-pointed mind.
items.inference: A further wonderful teaching is to be heard attentively.
items.plain_english: Hear another wonderful thing, O goddess, with one-pointed mind.

items.question: What range from Śiva to Avīci is meditated in place?
premises: In place, in place, indeed, having meditated that.
It extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
items.inference: The meditation spans from Śiva to Avīci.
items.plain_english: In place, having meditated that, it extends from Śiva down to Avīci.

items.question: What issues forth from hair pores resembling milk and snow?
premises: It issued forth from hair pores.
It resembles cow's milk and snow.
items.inference: A milk-and-snow-like substance issues from hair pores.
items.plain_english: It issued forth from hair pores, resembling cow's milk and snow.

items.question: What independence and Śiva-equality result from free movement?
premises: He is independent.
He is equal to Śiva.
His movement and activity are by free will.
items.inference: The practitioner becomes independent and Śiva-equal through free activity.
items.plain_english: Independent and equal to Śiva, he moves and acts by free will.

items.question: In which bodily centers are the wheels located?
premises: They are in secret place, navel, and heart.
They are in throat, mouth, head, and tuft end.
items.inference: The wheels occupy multiple bodily centers.
items.plain_english: They are in secret place, navel, heart, throat, mouth, head, and tuft end.

items.question: How many wheels and petals are described?
premises: There are eleven-fold wheels, O goddess.
And thousand-petalled ones.
items.inference: The system includes eleven wheels and thousand-petalled wheels.
items.plain_english: O goddess, there are eleven-fold wheels and thousand-petalled ones.

items.question: What petal counts are enumerated among the wheels?
premises: Sixteen, hundred-petal, and crore-petal are listed.
Just as and also.
items.inference: The wheels include sixteen, hundred-petal, and crore-petal forms.
items.plain_english: Sixteen, hundred-petal, and crore-petal, just as and also.

items.question: What red subjugating wheel bestows great enjoyment?
premises: It is red and for subjugation.
It always bestows great enjoyment, O goddess.
items.inference: The red wheel subjugates and bestows great enjoyment.
items.plain_english: O goddess, the red one for subjugation always bestows great enjoyment.

items.question: What white wheel is declared for nourishment and peace?
premises: It is white and in nourishment.
It is declared especially peace-causing.
items.inference: The white wheel nourishes and causes peace.
items.plain_english: The white one in nourishment is declared especially peace-causing.

items.question: What heated-gold-splendor wheel causes city agitation?
premises: It has heated-gold splendor.
It is the cause of city agitation and so on.
items.inference: The golden-splendor wheel causes agitation.
items.plain_english: It has heated-gold splendor and causes city agitation and so on.

items.question: What goals and eight qualities are associated with the wheels?
premises: Dharma and wealth, desire and liberation.
And the eight qualities beginning with minuteness.
items.inference: The wheels relate to goals and eight powers.
items.plain_english: Dharma and wealth, desire and liberation, and the eight qualities beginning with minuteness.

items.question: What certainty results from practice for one devoted to that?
premises: It becomes thus, no doubt.
Through practice, for one devoted to that.
items.inference: Practice removes doubt for the devoted practitioner.
items.plain_english: Thus it becomes; there is no doubt through practice for one devoted to that.
